notes.title: Score Exchange
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/c96558ebc189b0fc0507ebc118dd58cf61b92a7e.png[/img]

A great event that will allow you to get points for the spent gold coins, which can be exchanged for excellent items.
[b]Features of this event[/b]
[list]
[*] If Score Exchange is launched in parallel with Lucky Draw, then 1 spent gold coin is equal to 2 points.
[*] These accumulated points can be used both in the Score Exchange event itself and in the Lucky Draw event ([i]points spent are displayed exactly in both events and if spend points in Score Exchange, they will disappear from the Lucky Draw event and vice versa.[/i])
[*] [b]IMPORTANT![/b] If the points are not spent by the end of this event, the points can be reset to zero if one of the related events - ends (Lucky Draw or Score Exchange)
[/list]


[list]
[*] [b]The current launch of the event does not include the parallel start of the Lucky Draw event, therefore 1 coin spent = 1 points.
[*]The number of exchange points for items in the event has been reduced.[/b]
[/list]



[i]Best regards JTGgame Team![/i]

unit type:

A festive event that will allow you to get unique festive troops, officers, you just have to collect the necessary ingredients for the exchange.

— [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/30e675be603470e313c4c1e8d567f19d3bc42470.jpg[/img] - [b]Halloween officer medal with exclusive parameters[/b]

— [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/03928cf607951827eac775d0b53732c8ef24eba2.jpg[/img] - [b]Bedwell Chariot[/b]
[we decided to please you with the fact that this type of unit from the [b]class is golden[/b], has two super skills
one skill is triggered with a chance, and the second skill is triggered on round 0 all the time]

— [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/34640cea10fe544f5ff186c755d25cb2d5bce4c3.png[/img] - [i]skill description[/i]

— [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/3ef555b78f1f0a11bfbccd2d75d63b4ea190215e.jpg[/img] - [b]and finally, the star of our holiday is officer Giovanni[/b]
[this officer will be effectively triggered if used on the Bedwell Chariot unit, since it has a parameter that increases the % chance of the unit's skill triggering]


[b]*Important:[/b] When the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1367720/announcements/detail/3061878350079115442]*Good to go*[/url] event is triggered, you will receive more items from instances.
